instruction: Configure Thunderbird to access an iCloud email account with address 'iclouduser@icloud.com' and password 'icloudkey2024' (no quotes needed). Complete the entire account setup workflow, ignoring any authentication or connectivity warnings that may appear.

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: iCloud email account setup task. User must configure both IMAP (imap.mail.me.com) and SMTP (smtp.mail.me.com) servers with credentials iclouduser@icloud.com / icloudkey2024. Evaluator uses firefox_decrypt.py to extract saved account credentials from Thunderbird profile and validates both incoming and outgoing mail server configurations are present. Same complexity as original task - requires multi-step account setup with both IMAP and SMTP configuration.
metadata.verification: Task validated against Thunderbird account setup process. iCloud uses standard IMAP (imap.mail.me.com) and SMTP (smtp.mail.me.com) servers. The check_csv metric will verify both mail server entries exist with correct credentials.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if both IMAP and SMTP accounts are configured correctly with specified credentials, 0.0 otherwise.
